gpu_bench_sum_timing: {warmup} s warm-up + {measure} s each · {total} s total
gpu_bench_sum_header: Renderer | Tiles | Result | Backend·MSAA | Load | Init | Scene | Compile | First draw | First frame | Ready total (excl. load) | fps | p50 | p95 | Max | Over 50ms | CPU p50 | CPU p95 | GPU p50 | GPU p95 | GPU done/s | GPU pending | Draws | Triangles | Heap MB | JS KB (sent/raw) | Note
gpu_bench_sum_footnote: Times are in ms. Rows are in run order (the renderer order shifts by one for each tile count). fps, p50 and p95 = frame interval. CPU = time inside render(). Compile = shaders and pipelines per material (WebGL includes the link check). First draw includes uploading every tile buffer. Ready total = init + scene + compile + first frame. GPU p50 and p95 = from submit until the frame start where the finished work is seen, so both APIs round up to whole frame intervals. Compare APIs by GPU done/s (below fps means the GPU fell behind). Notes: first_use = first time this page started that API (init includes one-time start-up), no_msaa = WebGPU compatibility mode turned MSAA off (do not compare directly with ×4 rows).

faction_rule_per_family: Each member family casts one vote.
faction_rule_by_shares: Votes are weighted by the city shares you hold.
faction_me_no_owner: You have no world record yet. It's created when you enter the map.
faction_locks_hint: Each opens once its conditions are met.
faction_city_threshold: Rebellion at {value} or less · warning at {warning}
faction_dip_scores_hint: Relation (favor) differs for each pair of factions. Faction trust is one value per faction that everyone sees, and it drops when a treaty is broken.
faction_treaty_offers_hint_vote: Alliance, protectorate, territory transfer, ceasefire and peace go to a vote. Ceasefire and peace votes are short. The leader signs the other treaties directly.
faction_treaty_offers_hint_leader: Under a dictatorship, the head of the ruling family signs every treaty directly.
faction_war_declare_hint: Declaring without a cause badly hurts relations with every faction and costs treasury funds.
faction_war_deadline_rule: If no time is picked within 24 hours of the siege declaration, the siege opens at this time.
faction_dividend_rule: Dividends come from city tax: issue interest is burned first, then city running costs are paid, and the remaining profit is split every {period}: by shares under capitalism, by shares under dictatorship with the treasury's part going to the ruling family, and all kept in the treasury under democracy.
faction_share_dividend_treasury: No dividend (remaining profit goes to the treasury)
faction_share_dividend_ruling: The treasury's part goes to the ruling family
faction_path_share_vote: The top-holding family opens a vote. It passes with 50%+ of shares, or is declared outright by a family holding 50% alone.
faction_path_family_vote: One vote per family in the city; a majority means independence.
faction_path_rebellion_only: There's no independence vote; only a rebellion breaks away.
faction_path_none_start_city: Start cities have no independence vote.
faction_occ_offer_hint: Accept to keep your building shares and join the occupier. Refuse or let it expire and you lose your assets there, get driven out and become hostile to the occupier, a target for attack.
faction_occ_restoration_hint: Anyone can contribute, and contributions become shares of this city in proportion ({count} per city).
faction_occ_restoration_mine: You gave {amount} {currency} · about {shares} shares once the goal is met
mail_preview_notice: You're viewing sample data. Send and claim buttons won't send commands.
mail_empty_inbox_hint: Items or faction currency that other cyborgs send you arrive here. Rewards and notices come as to-dos, not mail.
mail_recipient_hint: Cyborg names are unique on the server, so the name alone is enough.
mail_attach_hint: Units, Terra Coins and account-bound items can't be sent. Up to {count} attachments.
mail_attach_none: You don't have any items or faction currency to send yet.
mail_send_soon: Everything checks out. Sending opens soon — nothing was sent.
mail_err_text_invalid: Contains characters that can't be used.

dev_tuning_lead: Changes apply to this world right away (the pack stays as is). [Apply] checks and changes every staged cell at once.
dev_tuning_scope_live_hint: The server uses it from the next request
dev_tuning_scope_sim_hint: The server does not read it yet. Only the simulator and exports use it

dev_tuning_problem_n9_fit: N9: the stat sum must be between min × 6 and max × 6
dev_tuning_problem_n36_fit: N36: 1 to 4 element cells, points ≤ cells × 10
dev_tuning_problem_fatigue_order: N21·N23: fatigue band starts rise and stay at or below the maximum
dev_tuning_problem_food_order: N33: food zero threshold ≤ low threshold
dev_tuning_problem_n45_fit: N45: recruit cards per level — card count and total stats min ≤ max (at most 16 cards, total at least 6), 1–4 elements, element points fit the element count (1–10 per element)
dev_tuning_confirm_structural_body: {count} staged cells are structural values set by decisions (D-5054). Apply them anyway?
dev_tuning_confirm_revert_all_body: Return {count} changed cells to their pack values. This is recorded in the audit log.
dev_tuning_export_body: {count} cells. Put them into the pack with pnpm tuning:apply <file>, which bumps the pack version.
dev_tuning_copy_failed: Could not copy. Copy it from the text box.
dev_tuning_history_dropped: Removed (does not fit the new pack)

dev_tuning_cells_note: A read-only list built from the planning document 49. Names are the Korean names from 49.
dev_tuning_problem_stat_primary_unused: Stat weights: a primary stat would have zero weight in every row (a worthless primary)
dev_tool_balance_desc: Build team A and B parties, set unit stats, elements, gear and skills (save presets), and fight single battles or Monte Carlo runs. The weight table tab shows +10 contributions
dev_balance_lead: Compare what +10 in each primary stat does under the current table and your edited table. The server computes everything; [Apply] puts your edits into this world right away (the pack stays as is).
dev_balance_fighter_hint: Starts from an average new cyborg (all primaries 10, unarmed). Win rates pit this fighter with one primary +10 against this fighter.
dev_balance_budget: Runs × time limit must be at most {max} s (now {value} s).
dev_balance_primary_invalid: Primary stats are whole numbers from {min} to {max}.
dev_balance_table_hint: Weights are in ‰ (1000 = 1 per primary point). Probability rows approach the cap (‰) with the half constant. Editing a cell stages it; scroll the table sideways.
dev_balance_legend_formula: Formula row: weight cells have no effect
dev_balance_formula_hint: This row is computed by its expression in the Formulas tab. Editing its weight cells does not change the value.
dev_balance_contrib_hint: Each cell is how much the secondary stat changes when that primary goes up by 10. If your edits change it, it shows 'now → edited'.
dev_balance_worthless_none: Every primary changes some secondary stat
dev_balance_duels_hint: Seeded duels, half in each side order, merged. Timeouts are judged by remaining HP share; ties count as half. 50% is the baseline (identical fighters). Remaining share is the average gap in remaining (HP + armor + shield) share at the end, so it shows how far ahead +10 is even when it always wins.
dev_balance_duels_stale: The base fighter or staged cells changed. Run again to see new numbers.
dev_balance_weak: Weak primaries (+10 does not beat the base): {stats}
dev_balance_weak_none: Every primary at +10 beats the base more often
dev_balance_reloaded: Someone changed the settings first, so the table was reloaded. Your staged cells are kept.
dev_balance_err_invalid_settings: Duel settings are out of bounds (runs × time limit ≤ 2400 s).
dev_balance_err_unknown_weapon: That weapon is not in this world. Reload the table.
dev_balance_err_busy: Another duel run is in progress. Try again shortly.
dev_balance_err_timeout: The duel run took too long and was stopped. Use fewer runs or a shorter time limit.
dev_balance_err_unknown_entry: That cell is not in the table.
dev_balance_err_out_of_range: A value is out of the cell's range.

dev_balance_err_unavailable: The balance screen is not available on this server.

dev_tool_items_desc: Edit every field and class of each item, check server-computed previews, then apply what you staged at once. Applies to this world right away
dev_tool_buildings_desc: Edit each facility's construction materials by level band, slots and gathering, applied to this world right away
dev_skills_lead: Saved changes apply to this world at once (the pack stays as is; [Export] puts them into the pack). The server checks every field with the pack validator.
dev_skills_export_hint: Setting, weight, skill and weapon overrides go into one file. Put it into the pack with pnpm tuning:apply <file>.
dev_skills_new_id_invalid: An ID starts with a lowercase letter and has 2–48 lowercase letters, digits or _.
dev_skills_new_id_taken: That ID exists or was used and removed before.
dev_skills_pick: Pick a skill from the list.
dev_skills_bare_hand_hint: Only bare-hand skills work without a weapon. They always use the unit kind's natural weapon (physical) or natural elemental data (elemental) (D-490).
dev_skills_weapon_field_hint: The held weapon must have this field. Damage skills need the same field as the base.
dev_skills_reverted: {id} is back to the pack value
dev_skills_reloaded: Someone changed it first, so the list was reloaded. Your edits are kept.
dev_skills_err_unknown_entry: The entry is not in the pack.
dev_skills_err_retired_id: An ID used and removed before can't be reused.
dev_skills_err_duplicate_entry: The same entry is twice in one batch.

dev_skills_err_rate_limited: Too many requests. Try again shortly.
dev_skills_err_unavailable: This server has no skill editor.
dev_skills_confirm_delete: Delete the created skill {id} from this world?
dev_skills_confirm_revert: Remove the override of {id} and go back to the pack value?
dev_skills_cond_appropriate_met: STR or INT at or above the weapon's appropriate
dev_skills_costs_lead: Every action except walking costs stamina (D-418). These are base values; actual cost = value × STA score factor (setting N13). [Apply] takes effect at once.
dev_skills_mp_basic_hint: MP is spent only when the basic attack field is elemental
dev_skills_err_entry_changed: Someone changed the same skill first.

dev_skills_rebase_conflicts: Fields changed on both sides (your value kept): {fields}
dev_items_lead: Edits go into staged changes and [Apply] sends them as one batch. The server checks them with the pack validator, then applies them to this world.
dev_items_export_hint: Put this file into the pack with pnpm tuning:apply and commit it (same file as settings and skills).
dev_items_sleep_id_collision: same ID now in the pack
dev_items_fx_lead: Effects shared by skills and items (D-425). Applied changes reach the next combat data.
dev_items_fx_pick: Pick an effect in the table to edit it here.
dev_items_fx_primary_hint: Primary stat buffs (food buffs, D-472) aren't read by combat yet; the consumption runtime will use them.
dev_items_fx_exclusive_hint: Exclusive group (D-472, D-501): one effect per unit per group (e.g. food). The same effect keeps the higher value; a different effect replaces it after a confirm dialog. Automatic use switches only when better for the situation and never uses one when an equal or better one is active. The consumption runtime applies it.
dev_items_fx_usage_none: No items or skills use this effect.
dev_items_bulk_export_hint: Exports the world's {count} effective items (chosen category) as pack-shaped JSON or flat common-field CSV.
dev_items_bulk_import_hint: JSON (pack shape) or CSV, up to {rows} rows and {kib} KiB. Imports only go to staged changes until you apply.
dev_items_bulk_staged: Staged. Check results from the bar below show here by row.
dev_items_bulk_columns: CSV columns: id, category, subcategory, tier, startPrice, weight, stackMax, tradable, bound, enabled, name.ko, name.en, description.ko, description.en, tags (tags joined with |). Blank = keep, - = remove. Use JSON for equipment and effects. The old column name baseValue is read as startPrice.
dev_items_bulk_patch_hint: Applies only the filled fields to the picked items right away (the server patches current entries; start price ‰ rounds half up). Blank fields stay.
dev_items_bulk_err_too_many_rows: Too many rows (300 max; import in parts).
dev_items_bulk_err_not_entries: Not an object with an entries array (pack shape) or an array of items.
dev_items_bulk_err_bad_entry: Not an item (id, name, category, tier, startPrice, enabled).
dev_items_bulk_err_column_count: Cell count differs from the header
dev_items_bulk_err_missing_value: Required value missing for a new item

dev_items_category_locked: Change pack entries with a pack commit
dev_items_tags_empty: No tags yet. Create them under [Item classes].
dev_items_start_price_hint: [placeholder] Only the first market price when this item's market opens in a world. After that the market price is used
dev_items_world_price_none: No market price — the server market is not open yet (the start price becomes the first price)
dev_items_lot_hint: Market orders, prices and recipe amounts are per lot; storage and transport use base units (empty = 1)
dev_items_lot_hint_weight: One lot = {size} · market orders, prices and recipe amounts are per lot; storage and transport use base units
dev_items_bound_hint: Turning this on turns trading off.
dev_items_durability_hint: Wears every battle, more on a loss (D-496 289; amounts are settings d496_wear_*). Actual wear runs once owned items exist.
dev_items_slot_no_wearer: No enabled unit kind has this slot.
dev_items_field_kinds: Unit kinds that can wear it
dev_items_kinds_hint: Empty means every kind with that slot. Only listed kinds wear it (combat, preview and lab filter, D-494).
dev_items_creature_hint: Weight and steal chance when creatures carry it (D-494, used by the creature editor).
dev_items_stats_primary: Primary stat rows (this slot raises primaries only)
dev_items_stats_secondary: Secondary rows (except the two attack rows)
dev_items_elements_hint: 1–10 per element (D-450). Unit element = sum of sources, capped at 10 per cell (used in combat).
dev_items_combat_hint: 12 resistances, flat defense, penetration (D-421). Values from several items add up (D-178, used in combat).
dev_items_skill_unusable_here: Cannot be used with this weapon's attack fields (D-490).
dev_items_appropriate_hint: Not an equip requirement. One stat per part: STR for the physical field, INT for the elemental field, DEX for hit and crit, AGI for the attack interval. Falling short scales that part down (the interval gets longer); going over gives no bonus. Leave blank for 100% (D-502).
dev_items_cost_shared: Same value as the action cost table
dev_items_two_handed_hint: While held, the off-hand item is ignored (combat, preview, lab; never an error).
dev_items_ammo_hint: Ammo is one off-hand item whose durability is the rounds left (D-497). −1 per ranged hit, none at 0 — consumption runs once owned items exist.
dev_items_ammo_type_hint: Items of this off-hand type use durability as rounds left (D-497); each ranged hit uses one.
dev_items_ammo_capacity_hint: Ammo max durability = rounds held (D-497). Ammo exists only as this offhand gear (D-501). −1 per ranged hit, no ranged attacks at 0 — swap in other ammo gear. Consumption runs once owned items exist.
dev_items_use_hint: The same potion or food is one item; the amount follows the user's stat ÷ the appropriate stat ± variance (D-496 286, D-501). Using it runs once owned items exist.
dev_items_use_scale_hint: Amount = base × min(cap, user's stat ÷ appropriate stat) × (1 ± variance). The cap is setting N10, the same as weapon efficiency; variance is 250–500‰ per line (blank = setting, default 500‰). HP healing usually uses VIT, MP uses WIS (D-501).
dev_items_perish_hint: At zero it turns into the chosen item (D-496 288).
dev_items_preview_blocked: The draft has blocking problems, so nothing was computed.
dev_items_preview_overflow: The primary stat total is too large to compute.
dev_items_preview_no_slot: This kind has no such slot.
dev_items_preview_not_wearable: This kind isn't allowed to wear it, so it was left off (D-494).
dev_items_preview_rows_hint: Shows the six primaries and only secondary rows that change. Computed with the same functions as the unit screen.
dev_items_preview_weapon: Weapon (this world's effective formulas, middle roll)
dev_items_preview_use_runtime: Amounts use the sample unit's stats. Actually using items (including in combat) runs once owned items exist.
dev_items_gather_off: Disabled, so it never drops in this world.
dev_items_gather_shared: Shared with {n} enabled items of the same tier.
dev_items_gather_levels: Chance per lot at each facility level
dev_items_gather_table_caption: Tier chances by effective stat band
dev_items_gather_select: Pick and efficiency (49 P8): {stats} {stat} → unlocks T{tier}. Picks the highest enabled tier at or below it (no roll, no level bonus).
dev_items_gather_work_title: Progress and yield (old primary production, D-507)
dev_items_gather_work_summary: Base unit {primary} {pv} → progress ×{progress} · {secondary} {sv} → {count} per harvest · one T{tier} harvest = {required} progress → {time} (one worker)
dev_items_gather_work_formula: Progress = max(1, ⌊{primary} ÷ {divisor}⌋)/tick · per harvest {base} + ⌊{secondary} × {rate}⌋ (up to {cap}) · 1 progress = {tick}
dev_items_gather_work_grams: One ore = {grams} g (setting N44, one lot)
dev_items_gather_rows: Progress and yield by stat (primary = secondary)
dev_items_gather_note: Effective stat = worker primary + secondary + facility level bonus (setting N43). Facility level never caps the tier (D-506). If no enabled item has the rolled tier, it falls to the next lower tier. Edit the table in the pack file gather_tiers.

dev_items_usage_code: Used by ID in code or scenarios

dev_buildings_lead: First levels are built from primary raw materials and most higher levels from processed goods (D-508). dev_buildings_levels_hint: Time = material weight (kg) × {msPerKg} ms × level factor (settings cell M14). There is no currency upkeep: buildings keep their durability with repair materials (49 N50).
dev_buildings_gather_hint: The primary stat sets progress speed and the secondary sets yield (N32). Each level adds +{bonus} effective stat (N43).

dev_formula_lead: Edit secondary stats and combat formulas as expressions. Unknown names and syntax errors are shown with their position before you save, and the panel beside each formula shows how much each primary stat contributes for a sample unit. [Apply] puts your edits into this world right away (the pack stays as is).
dev_formula_generated: This expression is built from the weight table. Once you save an edit, this row uses the expression instead of the weights.
dev_formula_warn_range: For this sample the result {value} is outside the usual range ({min}–{max}).
dev_formula_warn_min: For this sample the result {value} is below {min}.
dev_formula_warn_div_zero: Something was divided by zero and counted as 0.
dev_formula_unused: Combat doesn't use this formula with this weapon (the bare-hand appropriate formula applies to bare hands only).
dev_formula_influence_hint: Share = difference from the result with only that primary set to 0, divided by the sum of differences. +10 = change when only that primary rises by 10 (exact).
dev_formula_influence_none: This formula does not change with primary stats.
dev_formula_items_hint: Appropriate values are primary stats (D-502, one per part). Ratio = the sample's stat ÷ appropriate (capped at {cap}×). Bare hands have no weapon share; their appropriate DEX and AGI come from the bare-hand appropriate formula (level × 1.5 + 10). Per-weapon appropriate stats are edited in the item editor (pack items.json) and unit_kinds.json.
dev_formula_reloaded: Someone changed settings first, so the list was reloaded. Your staged formulas are kept.
dev_formula_err_too_long: The expression is too long (2000 characters max).
dev_formula_err_too_many_nodes: The expression is too large (400 nodes max).
dev_formula_err_too_many_decimals: Use at most three decimal places.
dev_formula_err_chained_comparison: Comparisons cannot be chained (split them with if).
dev_formula_err_local_shadows: {name} is already a name, so it cannot be an intermediate value.
dev_formula_err_missing_result: The last line must be the result expression.
dev_formula_var_gear: Amount equipment adds to this row
dev_formula_var_buff: Amount buffs add to this row
dev_formula_var_w: Weapon value (attack, hit ‰, crit ‰; bare-hand attack 0)
dev_formula_var_s: Stat attack (secondary physical or elemental attack)
dev_formula_var_p: Stat checked against the weapon appropriate (physical STR, elemental INT)
dev_formula_var_a: Weapon appropriate stat (attack STR or INT, hit and crit DEX, interval AGI; bare hands use the level formula, 0 = none → 100%)
dev_formula_var_b: Base cost of the action (weapon or skill)
dev_formula_var_w_agi: AGI weight in the STA score (N13)
dev_formula_var_w_vit: VIT weight in the STA score (N13)
dev_tuning_err_invalid_formula: The formula does not read with that slot's variables.
dev_tuning_drop_invalid_formula: Formula no longer reads with the new pack
dev_balance_fighter_loaded: Loaded the base fighter (primaries after level growth and gear, plus weapon).
dev_balance_fighter_loaded_unarmed: Loaded the base fighter. Custom weapons can't be used here, so it fights unarmed.
dev_balance_fighter_source_pick: Pick a team A unit or unit preset
dev_lab_lead: Build a party (up to 6) for team A and team B and set each unit's level, primaries, K, elements, weapon, gear and skills. The server computes previews and battles with this world's effective values.
dev_lab_retreat_hint: The party retreats below this HP %. 0 fights to the end.
dev_lab_name_invalid: Enter both names, 1–{max} characters, on one line.
dev_lab_preset_read_only: You can only load presets (no write permission).
dev_lab_level_hint: Max level (N7) {max}. Higher levels still compute.
dev_lab_no_growth: This kind has no level or K growth (primaries = initial + gear).
dev_lab_rebirths_hint: Skill slots = kind base + rebirths (up to the cap).
dev_lab_growth_hint: Per level: primary = initial × (1 + growth {growth}‰ × K × (Lv − 1)). Rolled K range {kMin}–{kMax}‰.
dev_lab_k_out: Yellow cells are outside the rolled K range ({min}–{max}‰). They still compute.
dev_lab_elements_fit: Fits the cyborg creation rule (up to two basic elements, sum 10)
dev_lab_elements_unfit: Differs from the cyborg creation rule (tests still run)
dev_lab_weapon_elements_hint: ‰ per element point. Physical weapons add an elemental share; elemental weapons add a bonus (D-459).
dev_lab_no_slots: This kind has no equipment slots.
dev_lab_gear_hint: Values added to secondary stats, flat defense, penetration (‰), primary bonuses and per-element resist (‰). Gear never raises attack.
dev_lab_skills_hint: Higher skills are used first. Gear skills fill any slots left over.
dev_lab_skills_over: Skills beyond the slot count (dashed) are not used.
dev_lab_dropped: Dropped (not in the pack or wrong slot): {list}
dev_lab_arena_hint: Team A starts west and team B east in formation. At the time limit, the side with more remaining (HP + armor + shield) wins on points (a tie counts half).
dev_lab_budget: Runs × time limit must be at most {max} s (now {value} s).
dev_lab_watch_pending: 3D viewing coming soon — it turns on once the replay recorder reaches the server.
dev_lab_stale: These results are from earlier inputs (teams or settings changed).
dev_lab_monte_wins: A {a} wins · {aJudge} on points / B {b} wins · {bJudge} on points
dev_lab_monte_sides: Team A win rate: west (attacker) {west}% · east (defender) {east}%
dev_lab_err_invalid_unit: A unit has an unknown kind. Reload the lists.
dev_lab_err_invalid_settings: Battle settings are out of bounds.
dev_lab_err_unknown_terrain: That terrain isn't available on this server.
dev_lab_err_invalid_preset: The preset values are not valid.
dev_lab_err_preset_conflict: Someone changed it first. Reload the list and try again.
dev_lab_err_too_many_presets: Too many team presets. Delete unused ones.
dev_lab_err_sample_read_only: Samples are read-only. Duplicate one to edit it.
dev_lab_err_invalid_input: Some input is invalid (check number ranges and names).
dev_lab_attacks_title: Attacks and appropriate stats (bare hands included)
dev_lab_attacks_hint: Attack = stat attack + weapon attack × min(1, STR or INT ÷ appropriate). Hit and crit = weapon value × DEX ratio; interval = weapon interval ÷ AGI ratio. Bare hands have no weapon share; appropriate DEX and AGI = level × 1.5 + 10 (D-502). Without that field on the held weapon, bare-hand values apply.
dev_lab_results_empty: No battles yet. Press Single battle or Monte Carlo.
dev_lab_watch_hint: Watch in 3D replays the same-seed battle as Single battle on the 3D map.
dev_tool_recruit_desc: See and hire a city administrative building's recruit cards (no births; NPC factions use the same cards)
dev_recruit_lead: Humans are not born. They only join through an administrative building's recruit cards. Card count and total stats follow the building level; cards refresh every 12 hours and do not stack (D-469, 49 N45).
dev_recruit_ux_gap: The administrative building screen (where to hire, upgrading the building) is not designed yet. This screen tries the same server command.
dev_recruit_not_ready: The world or the NPC society runtime is not ready (off or starting).
dev_recruit_no_cities: No city can recruit right now.
dev_recruit_window: Window {window} · next refresh in {hours} h {minutes} min
dev_recruit_need_cyborg: You need a cyborg to hire (the cyborg owns hired humans).
dev_recruit_owner_hint: The cards the city owner sees in the same window. The NPC recruit rule buys the highest totals until housing is full.
dev_recruit_err_busy: The server is busy. Try again shortly.
dev_recruit_err_rate_limited: Too many tries. Wait a moment.
dev_recruit_err_no_cyborg: You need a cyborg to hire.
dev_recruit_err_unknown_city: You cannot hire in this city.
dev_recruit_err_cards_changed: The cards changed (refreshed or settings changed). New cards are loaded.
dev_recruit_err_no_room: No free cell around the city.
dev_recruit_err_internal: Hiring failed because of a server error.
dev_recruit_err_offline: Disconnected. Check the cards after reconnecting.
dev_recruit_err_timeout: No reply in time. Check the cards again.
